# IJC Global AI & Justice Innovation Universe (v0.3.0)

**Founder:** Cecep Mustafa  
**Repository:** https://github.com/bsdkijc-dev/ijc-global-ai-justice-universe

## Overview
An open-research dataset combining empirical comparative data from the **Oxford Institute of Technology and Justice — AI Justice Atlas** with a 12-dimensional generative portfolio (`8,957,952,000,000` addressable configurations).

## Epistemic Labeling
- `EXISTING_REAL_WORLD_RECORD`: Documented systems, statutes, judicial policies, and cases from 46 verified accessible Oxford AI Justice Atlas URLs (1 hub + 45 countries; Zambia `OXF-AIATLAS-44` recorded as `SOURCE_INACCESSIBLE` with zero-imputation).
- `PROPOSED_RESEARCH_PROGRAM` (`PROPOSED_UNVALIDATED`): 1,000 deterministic, schema-validated, TF-IDF deduplicated research configurations (`seed=202702`) and Top-10 regionally diverse pilot prototypes.
- `PROTOTYPE_EXPERIMENTAL_NONBINDING`: Synthetic benchmark results (`6/6` exact detection accuracy) for the offline Citation Verification Gate & Appellate Triage prototype.

## Included Files
1. `source-registry.csv` & `source-registry.json` — 47 Oxford AI Justice Atlas records
2. `access-log.csv` — Live audit access log
3. `jurisdiction_atlas_46.csv` & `jurisdiction_atlas_46.json` — 46-country comparative indicator matrix
4. `programs_curated_1000.csv` & `programs_curated_1000.parquet` — 1,000 validated & ranked research programs
5. `top10_pilot_prototypes.csv` & `top10_pilot_prototypes.json` — Top-10 regionally diverse 2027–2028 pilot prototypes
6. `prototype_benchmark_results.json` — Offline citation gate benchmark results
